newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy starts note tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy starts note tender offer.

text.p: Ocean Energy Inc said Monday it started a tender offer for $125 million of 13.5 percent senior notes due 2004.
For each senior note, the company will pay a total of 75 basis points over the yield to maturity on the 5.875 percent U.S. Treasuries due November 15, 1999.
The tender offer will expire at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT July 21 and is subject to completion of the company's offering of $200 million senior subordinated notes due 2007 to institutional buyers, it said.
Ocean Energy, formerly called Flores & Rucks Inc, also said it is soliciting consents from tendering note holders to remove the principal restrictive covenants in the indenture for the senior notes.
The tender offer includes $10 per every $1,000 principal amount for which consents are received, the company said.

To receive the consent payment, holders must tender their senior notes and consents by 1700 EDT/2100 GMT July 7 or on the first date after the company holds consents representing a majority of the notes' principal amount.
